runtime: Node 24 native standard library; no dependencies

settings.now: optional monotonic function returning nonnegative safe integer milliseconds; default Date.now

methods.createSession(): no arguments; returns frozen {sessionId,csrfToken,actor,createdAt,expiresAt}; IDs and tokens are independent crypto random 32-byte base64url values; capacity throws code TRIAL_CAPACITY
methods.authorize(sessionId,{mutation=false,csrf: frozen {actor,expiresAt} or null; mutation requires current session token; expired entries are removed; never creates a session
methods.revoke(sessionId): boolean; deletes current session; revoked IDs remain unknown
methods.sweepExpired(): remove expired entries and return current size

createTrialSessionManager.storage: bounded process memory, no persistence or timers; expiry occurs at now >= expiresAt; all sessions invalid after restart; clock regression throws

settings.port: required server-owned integer 1..65535 from actual 127.0.0.1 listener; never browser supplied

methods.bootstrap(req,res): await; explicit public demo POST with JSON {} and exact Host/Origin; writes 201 synthetic admission JSON with CSRF token and HttpOnly cookie; true on success, null after body-free denial; an existing invalid cookie returns 401; current cookie requires CSRF and returns 409
methods.authorize(req,res): await before private application work; GET/HEAD or POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE; returns frozen {actor,expiresAt,body}, where body is parsed JSON object for mutations and null for reads; null after sending denial; mutations require exact Origin and X-Trial-CSRF; Originless GET/HEAD require a current session cookie and matching X-Trial-CSRF; rechecks session and required proof after body input
methods.logout(req,res): await; POST JSON {} with current cookie and X-Trial-CSRF; revokes session, expires cookie and writes body-free 204; true or null

createTrialHttpGuard.input: actual node:http IncomingMessage/ServerResponse; raw headers checked, IPv4 loopback peers only, HTTP only; exact trusted Host always required; any present Origin must equal trustedOrigin; missing Origin allowed only for GET/HEAD with current session cookie and matching X-Trial-CSRF; if Sec-Fetch-Site is present on an Originless read it must be exactly same-origin; metadata alone never grants admission; duplicate Origin, Host, cookie, CSRF or Sec-Fetch-Site headers are denied; mutations, demo POST and logout POST always require exact Origin
createTrialHttpGuard.cookie: mesh_trial=<43-char ID>; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Max-Age=ceil(ttlMs/1000). HTTP loopback has no Secure flag; Secure is required only for a separately designed HTTPS integration. Server expiry remains authoritative.
createTrialHttpGuard.cache: all guard success and denial responses receive Cache-Control: no-store and Pragma: no-cache

deniedStates.400: malformed/duplicate/oversized headers or cookies, invalid/deep JSON, read body, nonempty admission/logout payload, malformed target
deniedStates.401: missing, unknown, expired or revoked current session, including Originless reads; expiry or revocation at final recheck
deniedStates.403: wrong/missing/nonexact Host; present null/empty/nonexact Origin; missing Origin outside GET/HEAD; Originless read with present Sec-Fetch-Site other than exact same-origin; nonloopback peer; browser claims/credential fields; wrong/missing CSRF for mutations or Originless reads
deniedStates.413: oversized or malformed declared body length
deniedStates.415: mutation body Content-Type other than exact application/json

createTrialHttpGuard.denialResponse: status only, zero body bytes, no secret details and no Set-Cookie; parser-level node:http failures are owned by the integrator

integratorOwns: bind server to 127.0.0.1 and get actual owned port before exposing routes
await guard before any protected work; return immediately on null
map explicit demo admission, private API and logout routes
read/mutation classification: do not mutate on GET/HEAD
do not use browser fields to extend fixed actor/capabilities
do not log session IDs, CSRF tokens, cookies, credentials or real user data
handle node parser errors with body-free no-store responses
set server header/request timeouts and bound other application resources
exclude private API and bootstrap from any later service worker cache
if async application work outlives authorization, reauthorize before side effects
excluded: real identity or human authentication; CSRF proof is not human identity
Agent/Mind or owner approval; CSRF proof is not Agent approval

integrationExample: After server.listen(0,'127.0.0.1'), construct guard with server.address().port and the server-owned manager. Route explicit demo POST to await guard.bootstrap; route logout POST to await guard.logout; for private API await guard.authorize and return immediately on null. Use only returned actor, never browser roles. No follow-on implementation until Echo independent gate.
